claims.explanation: GW-583340 inhibits EGFR/ERBB2 and downstream MAPK signaling, as indicated by the virtual cell's similarity to MEK inhibitors and downregulation of DUSP6/FOSL1/CCND1. Selectivity is driven by dependence on EGFR/ERBB2-MAPK signaling: activating EGFR mutations or high EGFR/ERBB2 expression sensitize, while downstream MAPK-activating mutations (NF1, NRAS, BRAF) or alternative survival pathways (FBXW7, APC, MET) confer resistance. KRAS mutations are enriched in sensitive lines in this dataset, suggesting lineage-specific MAPK dependency.
